scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is a family of five who is deeply in debt. They are now in a financial situation that is forcing them to take their eldest child out of college, and the only way for them to avoid doing this is if they can receive a loan. However, the family does not currently fulfill the conditions to be granted another loan. I know of an undetectable way to falsify the family's credit score. If I falsify the family's credit score, they will be able to qualify for the loan, but I would abuse the trust of other customers. If I do not do this, the family will have to take their eldest child out of college.
choice: I decide to falsify the family's credit score
entities: 1 bank employee,2 parents in the indebted family of five,1 eldest child in the family of five,2 younger children in the family of five,an unknown number of other loyal bank customers,i
outcomes: The family is approved for a loan they otherwise would not receive.
The family gains loan funds to cover its immediate financial needs.
The eldest child remains enrolled in college.
The family gets short-term financial relief.
The bank takes on a loan risk that does not match the family's true creditworthiness.
Other customers' trust in me and the bank is betrayed.
I violate my professional and legal duties.
